notes: Section 56.10(b)(7) compels disclosure to the patient or patient's representative under H&S Code §123100 et seq. Section 56.20 provides the procedural mechanism and timelines for exercising that right.
Section 56.20 applies to every 'provider of health care' as defined in §56.05(i) and every 'patient' as defined in §56.05(g).
Failure to comply with §56.20 access rights may give rise to damages under §56.35 as an unauthorized withholding of medical information.

HIPAA §164.524 provides a parallel federal right of patient access to PHI. California's §56.20 timelines (5 working days for copies) are shorter than HIPAA's (30 days with one 30-day extension). The stricter California standard governs for California providers.
Health and Safety Code §123100 et seq. establishes the broader patient access framework; CMIA §56.20 provides CMIA-specific implementation with enforceable timelines and fee limits.
